notes.title: 3.1.0 Public Test Build
notes.content:
Sorry we've been gone for a year but we have been actively working. We have just released a public test build of 3.1.0 that adds a ton of fixes and updates including:

UPDATES


Armors are now color coded:
 Magic Armor: Blue
 Heavy Armor: Red
 Common Armor: Green
 The Accessory/Charm mechanic has been revamped:
 The Accessory system has been removed
 There are now 3 charm slots
 Charms are now split into 3 categories:
 Magic Charms: Blue
 Heavy Charms: Red
 Common Charms: Green
 Rebalanced some Charm effects:
 Made the Frost, Flame, and Electronic bands resist their respective elements by +25% instead of making the user immune
 Made the Frost, Flame, and Electric rings resist their respective elements by +60% instead of making the user absorb
 Battle Items are now color coded: 
 Healing: Pink
 Magic Restore: Blue 
 Food: Green
 Status Healing: Yellow
 Corrected skill terminology for consistency:
 Miniscule/Minor
 Moderate
 Heavy
 Severe
 Added a Credits and Changelog Window InGame
 Made new Icons for Sync Spells and Pierce Attacks, and corrected a few Icons as well
 Updated the Battle Results Screen
 Changed the color of HP from orange to pink for consistency
 Made a custom font (other fonts can be used in the menu)
 Tweaked the Battle Quicktime Event to be more responsive
 Tweaked a lot enemy stats for balancing
 Tuned some maps to work better for optimization and gameplay
 Elemental and Physical spell costs has been increased
 Quill, Antonio, & Chollie have been buffed
 Rebalance Physical and Magical skills for consistency
 Updated the Tutorials to be quicker and more accurate
 Updated the Demon Invasion Guidebook with completed tutorials
 Added working monster book to view enemy stats and drop rates
 LevelUp bars now only level up one party member per bar.
 Updated the items in Item Bundles for balancing
 Items have different inventory limits
 Updated the Neon Station Dungeon for visuals and optimization
 Updated the Stone Creek Caves Dungeon for visuals and optimization
 Updated the Pinechester Mansion Dungeon for visuals and optimization
 Updated the button graphics for the title screen
 Updated the logo for the title screen
 Updated graphics for intro cutscene
 Updated some models and textures
 Updated some of the cutscenes
 Updated some of the Poltergeist sprites
 Updated the Warden sprite
 Updated weapon, charms, and item name descriptions
 Updated and added new icons
 Updated the "Status" menu with the "Stats" menu since its original purpose was redundant
 Updated Soul Carve, now drains MP
 All Sync Spells cost Max Stamina and now do Aether Damage
 Added the toggle option to hide following party members


BUG FIXES



 Temporarily removed the skill Frenzy due to it crashing the game
 Removed walls that block the player's vision on certain maps
 Fixed a fatal error with the Mirror boss "TypeError: BattleManager[_0x1f71f5(...)] is not a function"
 Fixed a problem where most models turn towards the player when engaged
 Fixed a few early enemies giving out too much EXP
 Fixed a bug where some attack animations were not showing up
 Fixed a few event functions
 Fixed a problem where the timer event does not work in the Quillogeist battle.
 Fixed a problem where some group status effects only targeted one person
 Fixed a problem where Cholligeist was WAY too aggressive
 Fixed a problem where the Warden and Mirror bosses has graphical glitches
 Fixed a bug where using the sync spell Hailstorm did fire damage
 Fixed a bug where some physical attacks didn't have their animations
 Fixed an error where the LevelUp Bar leveled everyone instead of the selected character
 Fixed an error where Otus would not buy back sold items


Music Related Updates


 Updated the Track "Epic Proportions"
 Updated the Track "Neon Dungeon"
 Updated the Track "Pinchester Mansion Boss Battle"

notes.title: 3.0.6 A Little More Polish
notes.content:
MAIN FIXES

ADDED THINGIES

 Aura can learn Toxic Fire

BUG FIXES

 Fixed an error that allowed a few statuses to carry outside of battle
 Fixed an error that made it impossible for dual element spells to do proper damage
 Fixed a bug that caused the battle music not to change when promoted
 Fixed a bug where the Loggia innkeeper disappeared mid cutscene


UPDATES


 Redid Antonio's Apartment
 Bows do Pierce damage instead of Physical
 Updated the Deadblin's moveset
 Made the Quillogeist more balanced, the timer starts at second phase instead

Music Related Updates


 Spirit Tile Jingle
 Victory!

notes.title: ✨✨ 3.0 UPDATE FOR PARADIGM SHIFT DEMO IS OUT NOW ON STEAM ✨✨
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/429467d669ad3a1bdc5e3b97e38b53528a384692.png
After several, several, several and several months, the early access 3.0 update has finally come out on itch.io (and soonSteam)! There have been several hurdles, including the entire team getting sick in the middle of development, but we managed to pull through to deliver what we can to update our demo.



The mac version is still being tested, we will make a post when its out. Sorry for the inconvenience!
Additions Include: 
- Making the entire game 3D (seriously) 

-A completely new battle system!

- Buffed the whole cast

- New ambush/surprise combat system

- Recreated dungeons and puzzles

- Updated UI

- Updated Options menu to adjust difficulty and 3D settings for optimization and FPS issues

- Antonio and Aura finally doesn't look like a goblin

- Updated balancing between each of the elements in battle

- The mansion and neon station have been completely redone

- Updated some attack animations (Still a big WIP)

-Revamped Sync Spells

Remember if you have any issues and bugs while playing don't hesitate to report them in the dissuasions tab.

We will also be doing bug fixes throughout the month as well so constructive comments are seriously appreciated!

See ya next update!

-Lunar Boon{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/dd9d175910bf2c7913da227bacb74ed3a4dd52e8.png

notes.title: Paradigm Shift Updates and News
notes.content:
Where the heck have ya'll been?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/6050cced58fc408f12c492bbbc2b36bea4bf4768.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/598415ac1cc9fb831b80afaceac9b44b0ca07f7a.png

So It's been a hot minute since the last update and it's because we've been working really hard for this update. The game currently struggles to shift from 2d to 3d so we decided to completely convert the game areas to 3d. One of the big reasons this has been a while is also the implementation of 3d models, we didn't expect to need a lot but we're getting through.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/bcf9cc91894b362a2343a04fbb3635cccfc4f9a6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/c48fdb56d480b798ffb1edf79d03b4e356f7ff02.png

We've taken this opportunity to also revamped and tweak a lot of the maps, in general, to make the game look better as well. So please keep and eye out near December, we hope to be very close to finalizing Chapter 1.

-The Lunar Boon Team

notes.title: Paradigm Shift 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/469c6229c298ea4ccdcc9c802630fd014f1e619f.png
Where Have We Been?!

We're sorry for being silent for months, we have been posting updates on our Twitter and itch.io. Now that we have access to the update page, you'll receive updates on steam too! So in the five months, we've been gone, we've added a lot of changes including enemy animations, new cutscenes, and updated assets. You can check the changelog below.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/e7ceb76b1a91ac633a03110dd11d5dd4d183b6cd.png


Changelog 2.0.0


Bug-Fixes


 The game is overall more stable
 Fixed numerous soft locking bugs throughout the story
 Rebalanced all the playable characters from scratch
 Rebalanced all enemy encounters
 Updated item prices and effects for balancing
 Fixed numerous spelling and grammar errors
 Updated numerous overworld sprites
 Made the mansion segment MUCH more playable
 Rebalanced Mansion Bosses drastically
 Fixed some attacks missing animations
 Vurpling weakness has been corrected


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/21e524180b4037dd71baa3f064fe27b663da27d7.gif

Updates

 Re-align NPC's
 Replaced even more "default rpgmaker" tilesets
 Updated a lot of stone creek resources
 Updated a lot of mansion resources
 Drastically revamped the Last boss fight
 Visuals for status effects have been added!
 Replaced the track "The Distortion" with "The City Shockwave"
 Updated the track "Fight or Flight"
 Updated the track "Going Down"
 Updated the track "Neon Dungeon"
 Updated the track "Poetic Echoes"
 Updated the track "Antonio"
 Updated the track "Snowy Stadium"
 Replaced Stadium battle background
 Changed the talking sound effect
 Changed the Fusion Names from the actor to the actor the move is used with: 

(EX: Newtwon's Fusion has Antonio's name in parentheses instead of his own name)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39477302/8962dcfdb3d75fbb131a32fad0284ce0b7528f79.gif

Additions & New Features


 CITY AREAS HAVE A 3D EFFECT! (The whole game is not 3D)
 ENEMIES ARE NOW ANIMATED!
 Added over 6 new cutscene art!
 Added a new Difficulty Slider (it can be used at any time!)
 Add new battle position mechanic to both the party and enemies (Tutorial included)
 New time skip dialogue
 Added new optional boss in the Mansion >:D
 Different floors have different footstep sound
 New Ernesto Cutscene
 Added character themes for, Newton, Chollie, Aura, and Lauren!
 Added more animations for status effect attacks
 Added 2 new mansion enemies
 Added Burning as a status effect to replace high blood pressure
 If you're buying you become weak to both fire and ice for that turn!
 Added a tutorial book called "Demon Invasion Survival Book" that updates with new tutorials!
 Added a working enemy counter system for some bosses and enemy skills
 Drastically revamped the "Gallary Place" Area
 You can now change the battle speed!
